svg.title: Spencer-Server home and Tailscale network

g.text: seen by Plex via SSDP / DLNA
• Exit node: raspberrypi (LAN access allowed, so SSH stays up)
• Gateway: ip_forward on, ICMP redirects off
• ufw NAT (masquerade) + MSS clamp out tailscale0
• ufw default deny · dashboards LAN + tailnet · Plex LAN
• Docker stacks: ~/Desktop/docker/ · timed jobs: see Automation ↓
MC world: restic nightly 03:30 · 7 daily / 4 weekly / 6 monthly
live (no downtime) · ~1.2 GB · + updater pre-update backups
players online: 5-min chat warning + 10 s countdown
at a separate site with its own internet
Monitored: Kuma ping + "traffic via Pi" keyword check
Linux · shared in from another account (a-friend@) · not managed here
OUT iPhone ntfy app · Homarr widget
kept ~12 h on ntfy.sh · via the exit node
Exit tunnel: all server traffic + NATed tunneled LAN clients.
Logical path; the WireGuard packets ride the home internet.
Traffic leaves the Pi's site as 198.51.100.20.
Home WAN 203.0.113.10: Tailscale's own UDP, plus replies sent
Remote access over tailnet: Homarr :7575 · Kuma :3001 · Beszel :8090.
Monitoring: Kuma ping + Beszel hub → Pi agent :45876.
Alerts → ntfy.sh (private topic): health report, watchdog, updater,
backups + Uptime Kuma → iPhone ntfy app + Homarr Notifications widget.
Samsung TV: Plex app streams straight from :32400 over the LAN
(no tunnel). Plex also finds the TV as a DLNA renderer via SSDP.
Friends join example.duckdns.org → home IP 203.0.113.10 → router
port-forward TCP 25565 → Minecraft. Whitelist (7 players) enforced.
duckdns-update (every 5 min) is sent from 192.168.1.179 so rule 5209
routes it out the HOME WAN - DuckDNS records the home IP, not the Pi's.
Minecraft world backed up live every night (restic, 17 restore points),
same SSD for now - copy to the new drive later. Restore: mc-backup restore.
Players online get a 5-minute chat warning + 10 s countdown first.
COMMANDS.md - command cheat sheet by task: health, maintenance,
README.md - how everything works and why (also Claude's 08:00 context)
network-diagram.svg - this diagram · tool sources + installers in subfolders
AUTOMATION · systemd timers on Spencer-Server (New York time) · every result → ntfy (see 6)
Plus: Uptime Kuma checks every 60 s (instant down/up pushes) · Plex snap self-updates ~4×/day · Ubuntu security updates via unattended-upgrades
